title: Search History Privacy Risk Calculator - Check Your Exposure
metaDescription: Calculate your search history privacy risk score. Assess data retention, sharing habits, and get actionable steps to protect your search privacy.
description: Evaluate your search history privacy risks across devices and platforms. Get a personalized risk score and learn how to better protect your search data from tracking, ads, and unwanted exposure on shared devices.

inputs.label: How many years have you been using the same search engine account?
inputs.helpText: Longer histories create larger privacy risks

inputs.label: Primary search engine
inputs.helpText: Different engines have varying data retention policies

inputs.label: Do you share devices with others?
Have you enabled auto-delete for search history?
How often do you use private/incognito browsing?
Do you search for sensitive topics?
inputs.helpText: Health, financial, or personal topics increase privacy concerns

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your overall search history privacy risk (0-100)

outputFields.label: Estimated Data Retention
outputFields.description: How long your searches are likely stored

formula: let score = 0; const years = inputs.yearsOfSearching; if(years === 'less-than-1') score += 5; else if(years === '1-2') score += 15; else if(years === '3-5') score += 30; else if(years === '6-10') score += 50; else score += 70; if(inputs.searchEngine === 'google') score += 25; else if(inputs.searchEngine === 'bing' || inputs.searchEngine === 'yahoo') score += 20; else if(inputs.searchEngine === 'duckduckgo' || inputs.searchEngine === 'private-engine') score += 5; const sharing = inputs.deviceSharing; if(sharing === 'never') score += 0; else if(sharing === 'sometimes') score += 10; else if(sharing === 'family-computer') score += 15; else if(sharing === 'work-device') score += 20; else score += 25; const autoDelete = inputs.autoDeleteEnabled; if(autoDelete === 'yes-3months') score -= 15; else if(autoDelete === 'yes-18months') score -= 10; else if(autoDelete === 'yes-36months') score -= 5; else if(autoDelete === 'no') score += 15; else score += 10; const incognito = inputs.incognitoUsage; if(incognito === 'always') score -= 20; else if(incognito === 'often') score -= 10; else if(incognito === 'sometimes') score -= 5; else if(incognito === 'rarely') score += 5; else score += 15; const sensitive = inputs.sensitiveSearches; if(sensitive === 'never') score += 0; else if(sensitive === 'rarely') score += 5; else if(sensitive === 'sometimes') score += 10; else if(sensitive === 'often') score += 20; else score += 30; score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score)); let grade, retention; if(score <= 25) { grade = 'Low Risk'; retention = 'Minimal data stored'; } else if(score <= 50) { grade = 'Moderate Risk'; retention = 'Some data retention'; } else if(score <= 75) { grade = 'High Risk'; retention = 'Extensive data retention'; } else { grade = 'Critical Risk'; retention = 'Years of detailed history stored'; } return { riskScore: Math.round(score), riskGrade: grade, dataRetention: retention };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your search history privacy risk based on data retention policies, sharing habits, privacy tool usage, and the sensitivity of your searches. Scores range from 0-100, with higher scores indicating greater privacy exposure.
tips: Enable auto-delete in Google Activity Controls to automatically remove old search data
Use a privacy-focused browser or private browsing mode for sensitive searches
Consider switching to privacy-focused search engines like DuckDuckGo
Regularly clear your search history manually, especially on shared devices
Review and adjust your ad personalization settings to limit data use

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy practices! Your search history exposure is minimal.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some privacy concerns. Consider enabling auto-delete and using private browsing more often.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy exposure. Take action to limit data retention and protect sensitive searches.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Major privacy concerns. Immediate action needed to protect your search history.
